interim_user_observations: Grand Train, Ultima and Pearl seemed to work; Meteor did not seem complete. Observations occurred during the suite, not an independent full40-epoch visual review.
limits: Frame-property matches are bounded observed branches, not proof of every conditional outcome.
A complete bounded window needs separate effect/recovery interpretation and physical panel/speaker observation.
Distinct measured thread CPU omits other processes/kernel work and post-last-sample worker residuals; headroom remains provisional.
Pointer consistency is not independent kernel correctness; full trace loss or drift prevents reserve acceptance.
Only Meteor/Quasar have matched controls; no per-optimization prices or timer calibration subtraction.
CPU deadline gap is a recorded-region gap, not a guaranteed sufficient optimization target; uncounted costs and cumulative reserve matter.
A late nominally complete epoch with pointer drift cannot pass despite exact software accounting and no reported underrun.
